column1: PD Environmental-Toxin Target → Approved-Drug → Clinical-Trial Repurposing Database
WHAT THIS IS
Drug-repurposing evidence base. Pipeline: PD environmental toxins → their top human gene
targets (from pd_toxin_human_data_integrated.csv, TopGeneTargets) → approved drugs with a
direct mechanism of action on those targets (ChEMBL, max_phase=4) → ALL of those drugs'
clinical trials across every indication (ClinicalTrials.gov), with outcome & biomarker measures.
SOURCES
Targets→UniProt: UniProt (Homo sapiens).  Target→drug: ChEMBL drugs_by_accession (direct
mechanism, max_phase=4 = approved).  Trials: ClinicalTrials.gov (AACT: studies, interventions,
conditions, design_outcomes). Accessed via Paperclip on 2026-08-13.
SHEETS
• Toxin_Target_map  — each toxin → its druggable human targets (+ excluded artifacts).
• Target_Drug_map   — each target → approved drugs (UniProt, approval year, action type).
• Drug_Summary      — one row per drug: targets, toxins, #trials, #biomarker trials.
• Trials            — one row per (drug, trial): outcome measures + biomarker flag. MAIN TABLE.
IMPORTANT CAVEATS
1. Scope = ALL indications. Most trials are the drug's on-label use (oncology, HRT, ADHD,
rheumatology, etc.), NOT Parkinson's. Filter by the 'conditions' column for PD/neuro.
2. Target→drug is by ANNOTATED DIRECT MECHANISM in ChEMBL; it does not imply the drug was
tested for PD or that the toxin-target link is therapeutic. This is hypothesis-generation.
3. Outcome-measure text is reassembled from the registry 'measure' fields; where a trial has
many/long outcomes the text is capped (~220 chars) — n_primary/n_secondary give the true
counts and the NCT link has the full record.
4. 'biomarker_measures' = Yes if any outcome measure matched a biomarker keyword (PK, biomarker,
synuclein, neurofilament, CSF, amyloid, PET/SPECT imaging, cytokine, EGFR mutation, PD-L1,
receptor occupancy, dopamine transporter, etc.). Screen, then verify per trial.
5. EXCLUDED non-human ortholog artifacts from TopGeneTargets (KEGG/BlastKOALA cross-species
hits, not human drug targets): influenza PB2, bacterial mercuric reductase (MERA), insect
GABA receptor (RDL), plant/fungal laccase, lignin/manganese peroxidase, photosystem II,
ferredoxin hydrogenase, reductive dehalogenase, generic peroxidase, NADH dehydrogenase,
Lon protease, rice LOC4326471. Per-toxin list on the Toxin_Target_map sheet.
